newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,141.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,141.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell by 346.8 million Swiss francs to 3.14 billion in the reporting period ended November 20.
Statement of November 20 in millions of Swiss francs:
There were no borrowings reported for the emergency Lombard window after borrowings of 16.3 million during the first 10 days of the month.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 479.7 million francs to 1,989.6 million.
An SNB spokesman said the 346.8 million franc decline in sight deposits for the period was a reflection of normal fluctuctions and was not especially significant. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
